title: Global, Regional, and National Burden of Myocarditis and Its Impairment, 1990-2023.
publicationName: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
journalName: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
snippet: The impact of recent trends in the burden of myocarditis has not been reported in detail. This study aims to estimate the global, regional, and national burden of myocarditis from 1990 to 2023, using data from the GBD (Global Burden of Disease, Injuries, and Risk Factors Study) 2023.
